purpose: Test an adaptive RossFast certificate that runs K2 first and recomputes from the original base state with K4 only when the K2 temporal indicator exceeds 1.0.

authority.production_candidate_kernel_source: F-ROSS17 cached kernel as inherited through F-ROSS18

fallback.restart_state: same original request base state; do not continue from K2 candidate

scientific_gates.final_fallback_state_must_match_standalo: within 1e-12 head/theta dump tolerance on fallback cases

promotion_boundary: Even if science passes and shared-host screening is faster than Reference, F-ROSS19 remains research-only. Any production implementation requires a separate workunit, independent requalification and existing performance-host policy.
negative_result_policy: Do not tune thresholds, change fallback trigger, reuse K2 trajectories, or add K8 fallback after seeing results.
next_permitted_action: Create an inspectable test-only adaptive kernel/solver pair, then run science and paired performance qualification without modifying src/** or reference/**.
